text: {"domains":{"block_M":[16,32],"block_N":[64,128,256],"block_K":[32,64,128],"num_stages":[1,2,3,4],"threads":[64,128,256],"swizzle":[0]},"shared_memory_limit":32768,"weights":{"traffic":1,"launches":1,"pipeline":1,"footprint":1},"rationale":"Initial plan for M=32,N=4096,K=4096. block_M restricted to [16,32] since M=32 must be divisible and larger tiles would waste rows; block_N spans 64..256 to control launch count over the wide N; block_K and stages explore pipeline depth; threads [64,128,256] to probe warp layout given the proxy ties them. swizzle=[0] establishes the required row-major baseline (one tile row makes swizzle launch-equivalent anyway). Shared estimate max(2*block_K*(block_M+block_N)*stages, 4*block_M*block_N) with a 32768-byte cap, well under the portability limit for these small M tiles. Equal weights initially; next hypothesis: after baseline, expand swizzle and test a changed block_K/thread domain to see whether pipeline depth or thread count drives simulated latency, acknowledging this proxy is dimensionless and GB10 estimates are simulator-only."}
